model.description: One row per quarter, 1949 onward, of French GDP from the INSEE quarterly national accounts in base 2020, seasonally and working-day adjusted, as quarterly and annualised levels in value and chained volume, with quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year volume growth.
model.name: french_gdp_quarterly

questions.derivation: Select the quarterly and annualised GDP levels and the published quarter-on-quarter growth, and compare each quarter's volume with the same quarter a year earlier.
questions.question: How large is French GDP and how fast has it grown in volume over the most recent quarters?

temporal.meaning: Each period is the first day of the calendar quarter whose GDP flow, or whose change on an earlier quarter, the row carries.

validations.description: There is exactly one row per quarter.
validations.name: unique-period

validations.description: No quarter is missing, so the row four positions back is the same quarter a year earlier.
validations.name: quarters_are_consecutive

validations.description: The published quarter-on-quarter growth equals the change in the chained volume level within the rounding of the published rate.
validations.name: published_growth_matches_the_volume_levels

validations.description: Levels are non-negative, quarterly growth lies within plus or minus 25 and year-on-year growth within plus or minus 30.
validations.name: within_range
